sectionText:
Welcome to the Lost & Found Platform. This guide explains how to use the available features and helps you find or report lost items quickly and efficiently.
To access all platform features, create an account and sign in.

1. Select Register.
2. Enter the required information.
3. Create a secure password.
4. Confirm your registration.

You can register items that have been lost or found.

1. Select Register Item.
2. Enter item details: 
- Item name
- Description
- Category
- Location where it was lost
- Date of loss
3. Upload photographs if available.
4. Submit the report.

The platform provides filtering tools to help locate relevant items.
Available filters include:

- Category
- Item type
- Date
- Location
- Lost or Found status
- Keywords
The Map View allows users to see where items were reported
1. Open the Map View page.
2. Browse item locations displayed on the map.
3. Select a map marker to view item details.

Registered users can communicate through the platform regarding listed items.

1. Select Contact User.
2. Type your message.
3. Send the message.
Thank you for using the Lost & Found Platform.

ptext:
We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and the rights you have regarding your personal data.
By using this platform, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
ptext1:
When using the platform, we may collect:
Account Information

- Name or username
- Email address
- Password (stored in encrypted form)
Item Information

- Lost or found item details
- Item descriptions
- Photographs uploaded by users
- Dates and locations related to reported items
Communication Data

- Messages exchanged through the platform
- Support requests and feedback
Technical Information

- IP address
- Browser type
- Device information
- Usage statistics and logs
ptext2:
We use collected information to:

- Create and manage user accounts
- Enable messaging between users
- Process lost and found item reports
- Display item locations on the map
- Improve website functionality and security
- Prevent fraud and misuse of the platform
- Respond to user inquiries and support requests
ptext3:
Locations provided when registering lost or found items may be displayed on the platform's map view to assist users in identifying potential matches.
For privacy and security reasons, displayed locations may be approximated and may not show exact addresses.
ptext4:
We do not sell personal information to third parties.
Information may be shared only:

- When required by law
- To protect the rights, safety, or security of users
- With service providers who help operate the platform under appropriate confidentiality obligations
ptext5:
We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or disclosure.
However, no internet-based service can guarantee absolute security.
ptext6:
If you are located within the European Union, including Latvia, you have the right to:

- Access your personal data
- Correct inaccurate information
- Request deletion of your data
- Restrict or object to certain processing activities
- Receive a copy of your personal data
- Lodge a complaint with the relevant data protection authority
